claims.statement: The world tick is deterministic: the same state, intents and tick produce the same events and digest.
Combat resolves weapons, armour, healing food, flight, reciprocal PvE/PvP and levels; death drops everything held.
Quests advance from visit/kill/collect/deliver/answer facts, complete once and survive a restart.
Guilds create, invite, join, rank, chat, promote and disband, and membership survives a restart.
Logout and death drop held objects where the character stood; a restart does not respawn them; only the two-hour reset returns objects home.
A guest cannot play before authentication; one accepted command per 250 ms is enforced on every transport.
The world is 24 connected rooms with reciprocal exits, descriptions, details and zone-bound mobiles.
The WebSocket wire protocol is RFC 6455.
